'''1138''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] serving under [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was a part of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] occupation force, installed following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation's]] successful [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] attempted to strike against the Federation's forces, 1138 was a part of OOM-9's task force dispatched to meet them at the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]]. The Gungans were routed, but before 1138 could prove instrumental in the capture of one of their leaders, [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], the droid was deactivated, along with all other B1s on the field when the Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] was destroyed.

==Biography==
1138 was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in the service of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="tpm" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Gunray utilized a fleet under his command to [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in a protest against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] new taxation of trade routes. Soon enough, Gunray had his army invade the planet, and overwhelm the government, allowing the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] to seize control of Naboo. 1138 was a part of the occupation force installed under the command of [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]].<ref name="tpm" />

[[File:1138Binks-TPM.png|thumb|left|185px|1138, deactivated, falls limp before Bombad General Binks.]]
Shortly afterward, a resistance to Gunray's control of the planet surfaced, as a large force of Naboo's native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]] under the command of [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] massed at the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]].<ref name="tpmn">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> OOM-9 led an opposing force, of which 1138 was a part, to meet the Gungan army, and engaged the natives in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]].<ref name="tpm" />

The Gungans were eventually routed, and forced to retreat. As they were doing so, 1138 joined [[3B3-888]] in capturing Binks and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]]. As 1138 held Binks at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], however, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Federation's]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] that was orbiting Naboo and relaying orders to the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. As a result, 1138, and all other battle droids on the planet were deactivated immediately. The [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] head then fell off, before Binks pushed its limp body to the ground. Naboo's leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] was then able to capture Gunray, and reclaim possession of her planet.<ref name="tpm" />

==Characteristics==
Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="db" /> 1138 had [[Color/Legends|white]] plating, black [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]],<ref name="tpm" /> and, like every other B1 battle droid, was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> 1138 was equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]], which it wielded during the Battle of Grassy Plains. When deactivated 1138's head fell off of its own accord, a feature not shared by most of its fellow B1 battle droids.<ref name="tpm" />

==Behind the scenes==
1138 was created for [[George Lucas]]' [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and was featured as both an animatronic model and a computer generated character.<ref name="tpm-commentary">{{Film|I}} {{C|DVD commentary}}</ref> The character's identification number is featured on their backpack and is [[1138 (easter egg)|one of the many references]] to Lucas' debut feature film, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']].<ref name="1138 List">{{SW|url=news/beyond-a-cell-block-references-to-thx-1138-in-star-wars|text=Beyond a Cell Block: References to ''THX 1138'' in ''Star Wars''|date=September 15, 2015|nolive=1}}</ref>
